scripts.dev: npm run build:runtime && npm run examples && npm run dev -w @slate/editor
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run examples && npm run build -w @slate/editor
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run native:build && npm run tauri -w @slate/desktop -- dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run native:build && node tools/build-web.mjs --optional && npm run tauri -w @slate/desktop -- build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/runtime && tsc -p packages/pixelize && tsc -p packages/editor
scripts.examples: tsx tools/build-cart.ts games/jelly && tsx tools/build-cart.ts games/star-barrage && tsx tools/build-cart.ts templates/platformer && tsx tools/build-cart.ts templates/topdown && tsx tools/build-cart.ts templates/shmup
